source_snapshot.test_name_items: All SAS/SATA NVMe LED Check - Access /Busy
source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    Check if access/busy LED function works normally

1. Insert NVMe SSD into BP slot and check access/busy LED

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria: 1. Check system spec define LED function

deepseek_columns.ai_commands: Undocumented raw IPMI bytes plus `lsblk` inventory.
deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: Management result, device list and Access/Busy observation.

historical_reviews.deepseek: PARTIAL; neither resolves SAS/SATA versus NVMe nor generates device activity, and its raw command has no OEM mapping.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION / CHANGED; requires transport resolution, isolated target, bounded I/O, safe insertion and physical correlation.

original_test_intent: Validate an Access/Busy LED for every approved drive/bay using real target-bound I/O, but the source does not resolve whether the drive path is SAS/SATA or NVMe.
original_method: Preserve two transport-specific alternatives pending decision: SAS/SATA requires HBA/enclosure/SAS-address mapping and a safe logical target; NVMe requires adapter/controller/namespace mapping. In either path an operator inserts the drive and observes the physical LED during bounded I/O.
manual_activity: The eventual core includes physical insertion and visual LED judgment, but the operator and agent cannot identify compatible bays, devices or the I/O target until the transport conflict is resolved.
required_inputs: Serial-bound isolated test file/volume/namespace and workload bounds
Hot-plug/ESD, operator evidence and OOB recovery
safety_requirements: Do not insert hardware or issue I/O while transport and target are ambiguous.
Exclude boot, mounted production, protected, customer and unknown storage.
Do not use raw IPMI output or inventory as an Access/Busy stimulus.
Do not format or initialize a drive; use approved read or disposable-file I/O.
No automatic alternate-target, bay or transport retry.
agent_execution_scope: Record the conflict and prepare separate transport-specific target/evidence maps.
After resolution, validate stable identity and run the approved bounded I/O.
Collect controller/OS/BMC activity timestamps for operator correlation.
Do not claim physical LED behavior or verdict.
engineer_actions: Resolve transport and approve the LED/population/workload plan.
Perform safe insertion and visually record the LED during the activity window.
Review correlated evidence and issue PASS/FAIL.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Not applicable: raw bytes are undocumented and `lsblk` neither selects transport nor produces Access/Busy activity.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Issue no management write or storage workload until scope resolution; then use transport-native inventory and a serial-bound bounded I/O tool.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: SAS/SATA naming, NVMe procedure, Access/Busy objective and 15/8-minute fields are preserved as conflicting facts.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: After resolution, execute a per-bay idle/activity/idle observation synchronized with transport-native counters and a guarded workload.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Selected SAS/SATA or NVMe topology only.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record selected controller/adapter/backplane firmware, driver and workload tool.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Selected transport's LED and service documentation.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds the missing real activity stimulus and separates incompatible transports.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Management responses cannot prove physical LED timing.

project_override_considerations: A project may explicitly choose one transport and population. It must document the override and cannot claim the other transport or untested bays.
expected_evidence: Owner transport decision, population and LED specification
Exact bounded I/O target/configuration and transport telemetry
Post-health, Tool Result and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Test Set/item label the case SAS/SATA while the procedure explicitly inserts an NVMe SSD. The device addressing, controller path, safe workload target and LED semantics differ.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Core hardware and workload target cannot be safely selected before the transport decision. This is a genuine operation ambiguity.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Rejects its raw/list shortcut as lacking both scope and stimulus.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Adopts its scope conflict and safe-I/O analysis, strengthening the result to BLOCKED pending decision.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Keeps the physical/manual acceptance explicit without guessing the transport.

review_improvement: Prevents I/O against the wrong device family and a false LED result derived from an unrelated management command.
independent_technical_reasoning: Access/Busy testing requires a correctly addressed active device. Since the source conflicts on the bus and hardware, neither a safe stimulus nor meaningful physical mapping exists yet.
no_automatic_retry: No workload, physical action or alternate-transport attempt is permitted before owner resolution.
